Its only info line, that `R-ORDER-NOTE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` have no links, was already there before my change.

**Items in your summary, per the OSTF rules:**
- Items I changed: none. I only added `R-TAX-REGION`. Its text is no weaker or stronger than the code, and I changed no existing item.
- Existing items my change keeps true: `N-FAIR-PRICE` and `R-TAX-RATE` are unaffected, because I did not modify `tax.go`, `quote.go`, or any existing test.
- Tests the item lists: `pricing/regions_test.go#TestRegionByCode`.
